products.name: Mewtwo Collection
products.note: Three Next Destinies packs and the Battle City promo (Parallel Holo). The oversized Mewtwo-EX, the figure and the code card are not simulated.

products.name: EX Tin [Reshiram]
products.note: Four packs. Mix (Bulbapedia's merchandise page, the only source for pack counts): typically 1 Emerging Powers, 1 Noble Victories and 2 Next Destinies; opened here as Next Destinies packs. Code card and tin not simulated.

products.name: Forces of Nature Collection
products.note: Thundurus and Tornadus (Mirror Parallel Holo) and the Full Art Landorus, with three packs (typically 2 Emerging Powers and 1 Call of Legends in the real box, one retail source; opened here as Next Destinies packs).

products.name: Next Destinies Three Pack Blister [Riolu]
products.note: International three-pack blister: three packs, a Munna coin and a Cosmos Holo Riolu (BW33).

products.name: Next Destinies Three Pack Blister [Luxio]
products.note: International three-pack blister: three packs, a Munna coin and a Cosmos Holo Luxio (BW34).

products.name: Next Destinies Stage 2 Blister [Klinklang line]
products.note: Two packs and a coin, with Cracked Ice Holo Klink, Klang and Klinklang from Black & White (the reprints are not simulated). North America.

products.name: Next Destinies Stage 2 Blister [Gigalith line]
products.note: Two packs and a coin, with Cracked Ice Holo Roggenrola, Boldore and Gigalith from Emerging Powers (the reprints are not simulated). North America.

products.name: Next Destinies Stage 1 Blister [Zoroark line]
